summary.text: Sandra Jauregui is a Democratic Nevada Assemblymember for District 41 in Clark County, first elected in November 2016. The legislature lists her as chair of the Legislative Commission for 2025-2026 and her occupation as housing and real estate.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Jauregui was born in Monterey Park, California, in 1983 and holds an A.A. from Mt. San Antonio College and a B.A. from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
Her page lists her as an executive board member of the National Association of Hispanic Real Estate Professionals from 2012 to 2016.
Jauregui began serving in the Nevada Assembly in 2017 and chaired the Commerce and Labor Committee in the 2021 session and the Legislative Operations and Elections Committee in the 2019 session.
She was vice chair of Commerce and Labor in the 2023 and 2025 sessions, and she is a member of the Assembly Jobs and Economy and Legislative Operations and Elections committees.
